summary: Discusses multihoming considerations for DDoS Open Threat Signaling (DOTS), aiming to give guidance to DOTS clients and client-domain DOTS gateways that have more than one connection or provider. It is informational.

eli5.summary: If a house has two roads to the city, a call for help has to be sent the right way. This gives tips for asking for help against attacks when a network has several exits.

questions: how does dots work with multihoming
how should a dots client handle multiple providers
